purpose: Teach: 一色/小池/岩田/坂口/大山/山内/浜田/平井

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の一色先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren — inherit the research legacy of your mentor, Professor Isshiki.
lines.style: Firm, measured directive. Weight on the name and the expectation. Steady eye contact. A clear line drawn between task and trust.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。小池教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Koike's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest commitment. Slight forward lean. No hesitation — just steady agreement and immediate pivot to action. Respectful but not deferential.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の岩田先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — contact Professor Iwata about the joint research.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Slight pause after the name, letting it settle. No inflection of doubt. The tone of someone used to being followed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で坂口助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Yes. I'll attend Assistant Professor Sakaguchi's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Clear, methodical response. Each phrase lands with quiet precision. No rush. Demonstrates he's already thinking through the logistics.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の大山先生のご論文を読み込め
lines.en: Ren — read Professor Oyama's paper on the literature review.
lines.style: Another task, delivered with the same composed weight as before. Brief pause before the instruction to reset. Expects execution without question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の山内技官と連携します
lines.en: Yes. I'll coordinate with Yamamoto, our lab technician.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Slight nod implicit in the voice. Shows he understands the full network of people involved. Respectful, practical.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の浜田教授とも打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Ren — also meet with Professor Hamada about the international collaboration.
lines.style: Final instruction, adding one more layer. Slight emphasis on 'also' — expanding the scope. Same composed authority. Settles the full weight of the task.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、平井事務官に申請します
lines.en: Yes. I'll submit the funding application through Officer Hirai in the research office.
lines.style: Final affirmation, slightly warmer than before. Signals mastery of the pathway. Quiet confidence that he knows how the system works. Settling close to the conversation.
